acceptance: An explicit source-to-capability inventory exists, with decisions to retain, adapt, isolate or retire.
Representative current behaviors and safety invariants have reproducible fixtures or test descriptions.
Original repositories and live authorities remain unmodified.
tasks.purpose: Read the original Todo implementation and current Project Control adapters as reference material. Identify observable invariants, integration contracts, tests and historical compatibility layers. Record which behavior is product-essential and which is incidental or obsolete.
risks: Confusing historical behavior with a required public contract.
tasks.title: Inventory the original contracts and construct a behavioral baseline

acceptance: Each entity has a unique owner and unambiguous identity/lifecycle.
State/transition invariants and forbidden transitions are documented with examples.
Simple single-worker tasks need no ceremonial run/lane configuration.
tasks.purpose: Specify PlanRevision, WorkItem, Requirement, Run, Assignment, Attempt, Actor, Authorization, Evidence, Outcome and ExternalOperation, including references and lifecycle boundaries. Separate declarations from execution records and separate current applicability from historical proof.
tasks.title: Ratify one canonical model of work and its invariants

acceptance: Project Control is not imported by the standalone core.
Isolated import/CLI and disposable SQLite/Git smoke fixtures are specified and subsequently runnable.
Existing README/AGENTS/project settings are preserved and amended deliberately.
tasks.purpose: Ensure distribution todo-orchestrator, ergonomic Python module/CLI/skill entry points, versioned contracts, tests, no hard dependency on Project Control, and no reliance on a sibling source directory. Work with the new repository scaffold rather than overwriting it.
tasks.title: Establish standalone package boundaries and development harness

acceptance: Provider contracts specify inputs, authority provenance, receipts, failure/unknown states and versioning.
GPU interlocks, inference and job execution are expressly external, without duplicate ownership ledgers.
Provider absence blocks only operations that require it.
tasks.purpose: Define interfaces for identity/authorization supplied by trusted hosts, repository/source observation, Git workspace effects, process execution, resource reservations, and evidence receipts. Todo retains semantic authority; providers own mechanisms.
tasks.title: Define explicit trust and provider contracts

acceptance: Equivalent inputs compile to stable logical content and diagnostics.
The format does not expose SQLite or agent scheduling internals.
Ambiguous paths, foreign references and unsupported conditions are reported rather than guessed.
tasks.purpose: Implement a documented, expressive plan input that supports authored objectives, structured work, scope, decisions, acceptance, alternatives, provenance and explicit unknowns. Compile deterministically to the canonical domain model, independent of running workers.
tasks.title: Specify and compile first-class machine plan packages

acceptance: Direct and indirect dependency cycles are rejected with an actionable witness path.
Condition logic is bounded, typed and deterministic; arbitrary evaluated code is forbidden.
Cross-project references need explicitly qualified contracts/receipts, not fake local edges.
tasks.purpose: Unify tasks, checkpoints, interfaces, decisions, barriers, rendezvous and result requirements under one typed dependency engine. Verify whole-graph cycles and explain unsatisfied, unavailable, and unresolved states.
tasks.title: Validate the complete typed dependency and condition graph

acceptance: Repeated ingestion of the same logical package is a no-op.
Partial/omitted definitions are not interpreted as deletion.
Diffs identify affected tasks, requirements, attempts and downstream consumers.
tasks.purpose: Diff compiled declarations against accepted definitions without simulating arbitrary writes on a copied database. Produce precise additions, updates, retirements, impacts and conflicts, preserving historical intent and omitted fields.
tasks.title: Produce deterministic, inspectable change sets

acceptance: Active claims cannot be silently weakened by plan updates.
Retries cannot duplicate tasks, events, or successful operations.
Revisions, supersession and downstream rewrites preserve accepted historical evidence.
tasks.purpose: Commit typed change sets transactionally with optimistic authority preconditions, explicit actor authorization and stable idempotency. Treat mutation of active or completed work as a guarded lifecycle change.
tasks.title: Commit plan revisions and replan safely

acceptance: Old project-control-preledger and proposed_todos.json cases used in fixtures are ingestible or diagnosed precisely.
The canonical new package format does not inherit legacy path-string heuristics.
No old compatibility path is allowed to bypass standard validation and changeset review.
tasks.purpose: Copy or adapt relevant original preledger compilation behavior into a separate import converter, retaining source/provenance and explicit repository selection; lower into the new same typed plan representation.
tasks.title: Absorb legacy machine-plan import as a compatibility frontend

acceptance: Single-writer consistency and multiple read-only connections operate correctly.
Read methods never initialize, migrate, restore, or write a missing authority.
Schema evolution has bounded migration/rollback-or-backup policies.
tasks.purpose: Design one local transactional store for canonical work, plans, attempts, capabilities, coordination, evidence and effect intents. Maintain schema migration discipline and explicit read-only opens.
tasks.title: Define project-local SQLite authority and durable schema

acceptance: A semantic mutation and its event/receipt commit atomically.
No-op operations and exact retries do not create accidental revision churn.
History and logical fingerprints are stable independently of SQLite WAL page layout.
tasks.purpose: Define typed command execution and revisioned state transitions in one transaction, with receipt identity, event history and derived read models; avoid a redundant event-sourced database architecture.
tasks.title: Implement atomic transitions, revisions, idempotency and history

acceptance: Readiness and claim-time checks cannot disagree by using different policy implementations.
Blockers are typed and explain causal prerequisites, unknowns and conflicts.
Admission rechecks preconditions and fails closed under races.
tasks.purpose: Provide one deterministic decision engine for structural prerequisites, role/capability rights, source scopes, leases and safe parallelism. Use the same rule set for advisory reads and atomic admission, distinguishing observed eligibility from reservation.
tasks.title: Unify eligibility, authorization and conflict evaluation

acceptance: Raw role names in client payloads confer no authority.
Capabilities bind project, run, assignment, attempt, permissions and incarnation as applicable.
Revocation/expiry and child-right subset constraints are enforced.
tasks.purpose: Replace Codex environment-variable identity and hardwired skill names with trusted host-supplied actor identity and bounded, revocable capability grants. Authorize parent and child delegation without implicit privilege escalation.
tasks.title: Introduce host-agnostic actors, grants, and scoped capabilities

acceptance: Two competing claimants produce at most one successful claim.
Parallel-safe assignments overlap only with proven isolation contracts.
Expiry never erases dirty or potentially live work.
tasks.purpose: Attach exclusive ownership, filesystem scopes, named locks and lifecycle to attempts. Preserve dirty-work quarantine, process-unknown semantics and one-active-claim invariants; external resource reservations remain provider owned.
tasks.title: Rework claim and lease transactions around attempts

acceptance: A simple run can claim work without hand-authoring a lane hierarchy.
Complex runs can assign serial and parallel work with explicit role and isolation policy.
A work item, assignment and attempt have distinct identities.
tasks.purpose: Schedule accepted work through Runs and Assignments, with deterministic queues, role constraints and optional lane structure for parallel work. No dependency on an agent/model scheduler.
tasks.title: Define runs, assignments and optional worker lanes

acceptance: Claim/dispatch/capability are atomic or leave no partial authority.
Resumption cannot adopt expired, foreign or revoked work.
Terminal finish revokes its authority family and preserves accepted results.
tasks.purpose: Join assignment selection, authoritative claim, bounded capability issuance and dispatch in a coherent transaction. Make resumption stable under connection/process restart and ambiguous task/run selection.
tasks.title: Implement atomic dispatch, resumption and release

acceptance: Read/unread/sync cursor semantics are deterministic.
Blocking communications affect progress only through declared requirements.
Messages cannot embed secrets, uncontrolled logs, or grant new privileges.
tasks.purpose: Keep bounded messages, questions/answers, decisions, interface changes, rendezvous and blockers, with explicit recipient and authority scopes; do not turn the ledger into a transcript store.
tasks.title: Provide typed durable communication and decision synchronization

acceptance: One authored fact has one canonical authority and generated views cite its version.
Context refresh identifies changed/invalidated fragments.
Large source bodies remain referenced in external content stores.
tasks.purpose: Generate a task/assignment context capsule from the accepted plan, current decisions and source references. Version contextual findings separately; do not copy previously authored prose into successive task briefs as a source of truth.
tasks.title: Derive bounded, provenance-aware worker context

acceptance: Child scope and permissions are strict subsets of the parent grant.
Child retries, cancellation and acceptance have explicit stable identities.
The parent or authorized validator must accept a child candidate before promoting it.
tasks.purpose: Allow an authorized parent attempt to delegate bounded read/write work and receive candidate results. Children cannot become independent plan/run authorities or self-accept final outcomes.
tasks.title: Support restricted delegation and parent-mediated acceptance

acceptance: Requirement types and predicate semantics are versioned and validated.
Acceptable no-change and evaluated-not-promoted outcomes are representable without being called failures.
Required checks cannot be weakened by an untrusted worker.
tasks.purpose: Retain declared gates, checkpoints and evidence contracts without embedding concrete runners. Make required evidence and accepted negative results first-class, distinguishing acceptance from runtime exit status.
tasks.title: Specify typed verification and acceptance requirements

acceptance: Interrupted external checks are recognized and reconciled; no blind replay.
Evidence attempts retain exact input identity, verifier version and authorized effect.
External GPU locks remain in separate GPU interlock provider.
tasks.purpose: Use durable gate-attempt identities and prepared/executing/observed/finalized lifecycle. Call trusted provider interfaces for actual commands/resources; correlate completion with source identity, operation identity and receipts.
tasks.title: Track verification attempts and external execution receipts

acceptance: An input change during validation cannot produce a falsely current pass.
Accepted completion captures requirements, artifacts, source identity and evidence IDs.
Later source changes invalidate current applicability but do not erase historical success.
tasks.purpose: Require current applicable evidence for successful dispositions at the final commit, while preserving immutable historical acceptance records. Recheck dependency/requirement inputs after external execution and at acceptance.
tasks.title: Implement provenance-preserving acceptance of work outcomes

acceptance: Overlapping edits require actual workspace isolation and a qualified integration destination.
Dirty work, ambiguous commits and conflicts are preserved for owner review.
Injected crashes between intent, filesystem effect, and receipt cannot cause silent duplication or loss.
tasks.purpose: Adapt existing conservative Git-worktree, artifact and integration behavior behind a trusted repository-effects provider. Preserve operation-intent, idempotent receipt and conflict-recovery semantics without coupling the domain engine to subprocess Git details.
tasks.title: Isolate and qualify Git workspace/integration operations

acceptance: Inspection is read-only and reports exact preconditions and blockers.
Unprovable process or source state remains uncertain, not automatically clean.
Recovery intent references original attempts and effects.
tasks.purpose: Determine authoritative reconciliation from attempt, lease, workspace, evidence and external-effect records. Distinguish expired, unknown-live, dirty, irrecoverable and safely retryable states.
tasks.title: Create unified inspection of interrupted and uncertain operations

acceptance: No unauthorized actor can force recovery by asserting a role.
Repeat requests are idempotent and each transition is auditable.
Recoverable work is requeued without losing uncommitted source changes.
tasks.purpose: Prepare approved recovery actions, revalidate the exact authority inside the mutation transaction, and preserve state, workspaces and tokens that cannot be safely revoked.
tasks.title: Apply safe and auditable recovery transitions

acceptance: Completed work and provenance remain accessible after supersession.
Live work cannot be retired under stale or incomplete expectations.
Downstream requirements are retargeted or explicitly unresolved, never implicitly dropped.
tasks.purpose: Make plan supersession and quiescent run retirement explicit, with successor lineage, preserving accepted work and user-authorized handoffs. Avoid special-purpose SQL rewriting as the only route.
tasks.title: Supersede, retire and replace work without history loss

acceptance: Read-only operation never creates or repairs state.
Export/import preserve semantic identity, evidence references and version compatibility.
Missing SQLite state reports unavailable until explicit qualified restore.
tasks.purpose: Expose stable versioned read models and derived human-readable views; snapshots are backups/interchange artifacts, not silent startup restoration. Require explicit identity and revision checks for restoration.
tasks.title: Add trustworthy export, projections and explicit restoration

acceptance: Todo works without Project Control installed.
Simple create/preview/claim/report/finish workflows are concise.
Public contracts are versioned; legacy names live only in adapters where necessary.
tasks.purpose: Build clean domain-oriented application APIs, `todo` CLI entry points and a standalone SKILL.md that teaches agents how to plan and execute. Expose bounded receipts, errors and actionable next steps; keep internal state machines private.
tasks.title: Expose stable standalone Python, CLI and skill interfaces

acceptance: PC need not import Todo database tables or private plan functions.
Project ID versus repository root selection is consistent at the PC boundary.
Read profiles never gain mutation or initialization authority.
tasks.purpose: Allow Project Control to select a registered authority by workspace ID, provide trusted actor/permission context, and map Todo read/command interfaces to MCP. Keep Project Control source intelligence separate from Todo semantic truth.
tasks.title: Replace direct Project Control internals with a thin adapter

acceptance: PC no longer hosts an independent plan compiler as its canonical ingress.
Historical supported inputs pass through one typed validation/change-set path.
Apply remains an explicit operator-authorized action, not a side effect of read or package import.
tasks.purpose: Route native and legacy machine-plan compilation into Todo; simplify PC to permissioned plan submission, preview and result presentation with explicit authority preconditions.
tasks.title: Move plan ingestion responsibility out of Project Control

acceptance: No duplicate physical GPU/resource ownership state is introduced.
Unavailable providers have narrow, typed effects; normal planning still works.
Execution outputs, secrets and model runtimes are not embedded in Todo events.
tasks.purpose: Define how standalone Todo and PC adapters request externally-owned resource permits and execution receipts. Strip Todo background worker/host coordinator and CUDA-specific paths from canonical code.
tasks.title: Integrate external execution and resource providers without double authority

acceptance: A versioned parity matrix identifies preserved, intentionally changed and unsupported legacy contracts.
Regression fixtures require no live project authority or hardware.
Uncertain legacy cases are documented rather than silently normalized.
tasks.purpose: Build disposable fixtures from the old implementation for plans, claim contention, delegation, gates, integration, dirty recovery, semantics and PC adapters. Classify intentional behavior changes explicitly.
tasks.title: Capture pre-redesign reference fixtures and safety expectations

acceptance: No two active conflicting claims can be admitted.
Observed eligibility and transactional admission share the same predicates.
Idempotent retry and stale-plan rejection are reproducible.
tasks.purpose: Exercise property-based or model-based tests of graph validity, no-op ingestion, competing claims, capability revocation, lane scheduling and decision consistency.
tasks.title: Qualify planning, admission and multi-agent safety properties

acceptance: No stale evidence can be accepted as current success.
Uncertain external effects cannot be blindly reexecuted.
Dirty work survives expired claims, recovery and integration conflicts.
tasks.purpose: Inject failures at each external-operation stage, changing file contents during gates, interrupted workspace creation and conflicting integration. Prove quarantine and historical proof invariants.
tasks.title: Qualify validation, external effects and crash recovery

acceptance: Dry-run migrator yields exact parity/intentional-difference report.
Ambiguous or unrepresentable states halt cutover with a recovery path.
Existing runtime remains usable until explicit sign-off; no automatic live state restoration.
tasks.purpose: Test conversion from original Todo authority and Project Control integration, comparing semantic exports, accepted completions, evidence and run status. Do not move or overwrite live state during qualification.
tasks.title: Rehearse migration and opt-in cutover in isolated clones

acceptance: End-to-end scenario runs on a disposable project and produces inspectable receipts.
Package/version identity independent of PC install layout is tested.
Release gate explicitly documents unsupported providers and remaining risks.
tasks.purpose: Complete README, API/CLI/skill reference, schema/migration docs, operational guide, versioned PC adapter contract, release/source pin and qualification evidence; certify the standalone product.
tasks.title: Deliver qualified release and operator documentation
